Buying & downloads

Are the free plugins really free?

Yes. Every Sister Plugin, plus Bit-Gooser, Goose EQ and Goose Gate, is free. Payhip will show a price box: enter 0 and check out. If one made you laugh, you're welcome to tip the goose.

Where's my download?

Right after checkout Payhip shows a download button and emails you a receipt with the same link. Lost it? Log in to your Payhip account with the email you bought with, and every purchase is there to re-download.

Can I get a refund?

Because these are instant digital downloads, sales are generally final. But if a plugin won't run on your system and we can't fix it, get in touch and we'll make it right.

What payment methods do you take?

Checkout runs through Payhip, which accepts major cards and PayPal. We never see your card details.

Installing

How do I install a plugin on my Mac?
  1. Unzip the download.
  2. Open Read Me First.txt.
  3. Right-click Install <Plugin>.command and choose Open.
  4. Restart your DAW and rescan plugins.

The installer copies the AU, VST3 and Standalone app into the right folders for you.

macOS says the installer “can’t be opened”. What now?

That's Gatekeeper being cautious about indie software. Right-click (or Control-click) the installer and choose Open, then Open again. If that's not offered, go to System Settings → Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway.

Which format should I use?

Logic Pro / GarageBand: AU. Ableton, FL Studio, Reaper, Studio One, Bitwig, Cubase: VST3. No DAW? Open the Standalone app and play.

My DAW doesn't show the plugin.

Rescan your plugins (in Ableton, hold Option while clicking Rescan). In Logic, open the Plug-in Manager and reset/rescan the plugin. Still missing? Send us a honk with your DAW and macOS version.

Do you support Windows?

Right now the flock is macOS only, universal builds for Apple Silicon and Intel. Windows is on the wish list. Follow us to hear when it lands.

Licenses & keys

How do I activate a paid plugin?

Your license key is shown after checkout and in your receipt email. Open the plugin, paste the key into the activation screen, and you're done.

Does Goose Kicker include Goose Kicker FX?

Yes. They're one product with one installer, and one key unlocks both the Goose Kicker instrument and the Goose Kicker FX effect.

Can I use it on more than one computer?

Using it on your own machines is fine. Lost your key or moving computers? Your Payhip account keeps a copy, or contact us.

The plugins

Are these plugins a joke?

The names are. The audio isn't. Every plugin is real, working DSP you can use on actual records. Some of them just do the opposite of what you'd expect.

What's a Sister Plugin?

A free parody of a famous plugin that does the exact opposite of the original: a de-esser that adds sibilance, a stereo imager that collapses width, an Auto-Tune that detunes. Great for sound design, terrible for your reputation.

Is there an Easter egg?

Every Silly Goose plugin hides one. Look for the goose. Click the goose.

Can I request a plugin?

Please do. We keep a long list of plugins to parody and we love new ideas. Pitch us yours.
